text: Under the BHK interpretation, a proof of A ∧ B is:
choices: a proof of A or a proof of B
a pair (proof of A, proof of B)
a function from proofs of A to proofs of B
a proof that A and B are equivalent
explanation: BHK: ∧-proof = pair, ∨-proof = tagged proof, →-proof = function, ⊥-proof = there is none.
